title: BBC Mundo Analyzes Why Argentina-UK Malvinas Tensions Have Reignited 44 Years After the 1982 War
detail: BBC Mundo published an analysis examining why tensions between Argentina and the United Kingdom over the Malvinas/Falklands have reignited 44 years after the 1982 war. The piece explores the renewed sovereignty dispute amid recent Argentine sanctions against British companies and the Milei government's assertive posture on the islands, including plans for a new naval base near the disputed territory.
